baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated n-u'jiza governs Allah and then the pronoun referring to Him at words 5-6 and 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The incapacity branch and the escape/outstripping branch converge in a causative relation: the speakers cannot make divine reach come up short. The doubled construction denies not only their power but the possibility that any maneuver could impose failure on God.

activation_trace.role: Weakness and falling short supply the failed result that the speakers cannot impose on God.
Escape and outstripping supply the pursuit frame in which every evasive attempt fails.
The fixed divine name identifies the direct object whose reach cannot be frustrated.

changed_reading.before: The speakers simply admit that they are powerless.
changed_reading.after: They admit a relational failure: no action of theirs can make divine pursuit or governance come up short.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated verb is divided between fi al-ard and haraban.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause blocks evasion anywhere in the lower terrestrial domain; the second tests flight as an active maneuver. Repetition brackets location and motion, making the pair an exhaustive stay-or-flee topology rather than a single generic denial.

activation_trace.role: Eluding pursuit supplies the common evasive action denied in both clauses.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the bounded domain of the first denial.
Panicked flight supplies the mobile escape strategy separately negated by the second clause.

changed_reading.before: They cannot flee to some place on earth.
changed_reading.after: Neither occupying any terrestrial place nor converting location into flight creates an outside to divine reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Zananna at word 2 introduces two balanced clauses with categorical lan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root ranges from uncertain supposition to certainty after an indication. The doubled categorical denial pulls the utterance toward settled conviction, while the cognition verb preserves the sense that this conviction was reached through an epistemic transition.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication supplies the endpoint of the speakers' reported cognition.
Uncertain supposition preserves the weaker starting state against which the categorical conclusion is heard.
The repeated denial of escape gives the cognition a definite and testable content.

changed_reading.before: We thought that escape was impossible.
changed_reading.after: The verse reports a threshold from supposition toward sign-based conviction that every mode of eluding God fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier first-person zann claims concern speech that proved unreliable and a categorical claim about divine raising. Their recurrence makes the focus zann part of a retrospective sequence of beliefs under correction, so its certainty is newly tested rather than timeless or effortless.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication remains the likely endpoint of the focus cognition.
Escape and outstripping define the conclusion now being epistemically retested.
An unreliable matter or outcome exposes the instability of an earlier zann report.
Uncertain supposition marks another categorical zann claim as part of the same revisable sequence.

structural_cues: 72:5 and 72:7 place repeated zann reports before 72:12, each attached to a categorical lan claim.
72:12 repeats the first-person plural cognition formula and doubles lan across two clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three recurring zann constructions; I infer a retrospective correction sequence, while the live alternative is that each occurrence expresses an equally firm conviction without a staged epistemic arc.

changed_reading.before: The focus zann is an uncomplicated declaration of certainty.
changed_reading.after: It is a newly tested conclusion inside a record of prior assumptions, carrying both conviction and memory of epistemic failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier refuge episode gives flight a social mechanism: humans seek protection with jinn, but the transaction increases an overtaking burden. Lateral shelter through another creature is therefore not merely unavailable; the attempted refuge feeds the condition from which escape is sought.

activation_trace.role: Eluding pursuit supplies the failed goal of the refuge transaction.
Panicked flight supplies the affective pressure behind seeking an alternate protector.
Seeking shelter and protection supplies the concrete social substitute for escape.
Increase supplies the feedback arrow by which attempted refuge worsens the result.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the burden that closes around the refuge-seeker.

structural_cues: In 72:6 human men seek refuge with jinn men, and the stated result is an increase of rahaq.
The failed refuge episode precedes the focus speakers' denial of escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge followed by increased overpowering burden; I treat that sequence as a concrete failed-evasion mechanism, while it may instead diagnose only one abusive social practice.

changed_reading.before: No individual can run beyond divine reach.
changed_reading.after: Delegating safety to another creature is itself an evasive route, and in the packet that route becomes a feedback trap rather than protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers probe the sky and encounter guarding, a bright projectile, and watchful interception. This supplies an observed upper boundary for the focus topology: the confession follows reconnaissance, and flight cannot simply convert the earthbound condition into an open vertical route.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication receives a concrete indication from the boundary test.
Outstripping and escape define the attempted crossing that the guarded boundary defeats.
Lower ground opposite the sky supplies one pole of the now vertically closed topology.
Flight supplies the motion that cannot turn the tested boundary into an exit.
Seeking and probing supply the empirical test rather than a merely abstract premise.
Guarding supplies the active closure of the upper route.
The bright flame supplies the material enforcement encountered by a present listener.
Watchful interception supplies the waiting response that makes the boundary operational.

structural_cues: 72:8 narrates touching the sky and finding it filled with strong guards and flames.
72:9 contrasts former listening seats with the present discovery of a flame lying in wait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tested and enforced listening boundary; I infer that it is evidence for the focus conclusion about flight, while the live alternative confines the closure to illicit listening rather than every kind of movement.

changed_reading.before: The speakers assert a general doctrine of inescapability.
changed_reading.after: They infer a closed earth-sky topology after probing a formerly usable route and finding it actively guarded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the speakers describe themselves as extended paths and divergent groups. The focus first-person plural therefore does not erase difference; it states a limit invariant across opposed routes, moral conditions, and factions.

activation_trace.role: Escape and outstripping supply the shared limit applied across the divided collective.
An extended path supplies the several itineraries carried into the next verse's plural voice.
Divergent paths and groups supply the internal social and directional fragmentation of 'we.'

structural_cues: 72:11 says some speakers are sound and some below that, then calls them divergent paths.
72:12 continues immediately with the same first-person plural frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and a divided plural collective; I carry that collective into 72:12, while an alternative hears the focus voice as a generalized chorus that backgrounds the prior divisions.

changed_reading.before: A homogeneous group makes one shared confession.
changed_reading.after: Deeply divergent groups discover the same non-negotiable limit: no path or faction supplies an exit from divine reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse moves from hearing through guidance to trusting assent. This lets the focus confession function as a hinge: the collapse of evasive self-sufficiency is followed not only by fear but by comprehension, orientation, and settled trust.

activation_trace.role: Sign-based certainty supplies the cognitive state available for reorientation.
Failed escape removes the imagined route of autonomous evasion.
Understanding and compliance turn acoustic reception into an actionable response.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies a positive route after escape routes close.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response that replaces evasive uncertainty.

structural_cues: 72:13 follows the focus immediately with when-we-heard, guidance, and we-believed.
The same verse answers belief with absence of fear of deprivation or overpowering burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence from inescapability to hearing and belief; I infer a dispositional hinge, while the live alternative is that guidance alone causes belief and 72:12 is only a parallel confession.

changed_reading.before: Inescapability is only a threatening limit.
changed_reading.after: Recognition of the limit can clear an evasive posture and open a positive route of understood guidance and trusting assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later path language turns evasion into routing. Straight continuance is one path, but turning one's side away does not create an outside; the subject is made to enter a constricting, arduous ascent. The attempted departure is captured as another governed trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the attempted departure whose route is reclassified rather than freed.
Failed outstripping supplies the governing result of both possible routes.
The extended path supplies the positive course from which turning away is measured.
Turning one's side supplies the directional gesture of attempted withdrawal.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the counter-agency that places the withdrawer into a route.
An arduous ascent supplies the constricting trajectory into which the attempted withdrawal is routed.

structural_cues: 72:16 conditions abundant water on remaining straight upon the path.
72:17 pairs turning away with being made to enter ascending punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a path, a turn away, and forced entry into arduous ascent; I map that sequence onto harab as a captured escape route, while it may instead concern moral response without spatially elaborating 72:12.

changed_reading.before: Flight fails because the fugitive cannot get far enough away.
changed_reading.after: Flight fails more radically because departure itself remains routable: turning away becomes a governed path into another destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's later first-person declaration mirrors the jinn speakers: no one can protect him from God, and he will not find an inclined refuge apart from Him. The focus is thereby generalized from a jinn confession to a shared creaturely invariant, including the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Escape and outstripping supply the jinn speakers' side of the mirrored declaration.
Panicked flight supplies the focus strategy matched by the later search for refuge.
Protection under another's guarantee supplies the aid explicitly denied to the messenger.
Finding and attaining supply the failed search that parallels failed outstripping.
Inclining toward a refuge supplies the alternate shelter that cannot be found apart from God.

structural_cues: 72:22 uses first-person lan twice, denies protection from God, and denies finding a refuge apart from Him.
The focus likewise uses first-person lan twice and denies both terrestrial evasion and flight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct structural and pronominal parallel; I infer one creaturely rule across jinn and messenger, while protection from judgment and physical escape remain distinguishable aspects of that rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a limitation peculiar to the jinn speakers.
changed_reading.after: It states a creaturely invariant echoed by the messenger himself: status and species do not produce an alternate protector or refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later comparison of weaker helper and fewer number expands escape from locomotion to collective capacity. A plural group cannot turn allies, aid, or numerical mass into the missing leverage needed to frustrate divine reach.

activation_trace.role: Weakness and falling short supply the incapacity that coalition size cannot repair.
The opposite of strength supplies the comparative power deficit eventually exposed.
Aid and making victorious supply the external support that proves inadequate.
Smallness supplies one side of the explicit numerical comparison.
Counted number supplies coalition mass as a tested but insufficient resource.

structural_cues: 72:24 says the promised sight will disclose who is weaker in helper and fewer in number.
The focus confession is voiced by a plural group, making collective resources a live escape variable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparative helper-strength and number; I read these as social dimensions of the focus incapacity, while the comparison may target a later opposing group rather than retrospectively explain the jinn's confession.

changed_reading.before: Escape is a solitary fugitive's failed movement.
changed_reading.after: No coalition can aggregate helpers or numbers into enough leverage to make divine reach fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sentinels before and behind close directional gaps around transmission; the final encompassing and exhaustive counting close informational gaps. The focus's physical inescapability thus acquires a knowledge mechanism: neither route, concealment, nor uncounted remainder lies outside surveillance and reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Escape and outstripping supply the physical problem explained by total directional and informational coverage.
Disappearing into the earth supplies concealment as a form of flight that informational enclosure defeats.
The idiom of what lies before supplies the guarded forward direction.
Behind as the opposite of in front supplies the guarded rear direction.
Watching and guarding make the front-rear arrangement an active surveillance perimeter.
Complete encompassment in knowledge and securing supplies the total informational perimeter.
Exhaustive numerical accounting removes the possibility of an unnoticed remainder.

structural_cues: 72:27 places watchful guards before and behind the selected messenger.
72:28 closes the surah with encompassing what is with them and exhaustively counting every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarded directions and total encompassing/accounting; I generalize these into a mechanism for the focus inescapability, while the immediate surveillance function is specifically to secure message transmission.

changed_reading.before: God cannot be escaped because His power reaches every place.
changed_reading.after: Escape also fails as concealment: routes are watched, what agents carry is encompassed, and no entity remains unregistered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates concrete dictionary images of disappearance into earth and a grave-side niche rather than the default abstract senses. It remains anchored in the explicit earth-flight pair and the later multahad refuge, but downstream prose should present it only as a material resonance, not as a claim that burial is the intended referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fi al-ard and haraban permit a concrete test of whether going into the terrain creates a lateral refuge.

activation_trace.role: Lower ground supplies the material into which concealment might be attempted.
Disappearing into earth supplies subterranean concealment as an unusual mode of flight.
The side niche of a grave supplies the concrete lateral recess image.
Inclining toward refuge converts the lateral recess into an attempted shelter.

changed_reading.before: Running away across the surface cannot succeed.
changed_reading.after: Even vanishing into the earth or taking a lateral recess fails to create a refuge outside divine reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the rear-part image of ajz rather than the ordinary verbal sense. It remains tied to the repeated focus root and the packet's explicit before-behind sentinels; downstream prose should mark it as spatial wordplay that sharpens enclosure, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated root of n-u'jiza can be placed against the later explicit front-and-rear perimeter.

activation_trace.role: The rear or hind part supplies an unusual spatial edge to the repeated incapacity root.
What lies before supplies the forward side of the perimeter.
The rearward side supplies the apparent gap that the verse explicitly guards.
Watchful guarding seals both directional sides into a perimeter.

changed_reading.after: The enclosure leaves no unguarded rearward side from which outstripping could begin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates a peripheral ard image involving ahl al-ard with the concealment images of jinn. It remains anchored in fi al-ard, haraban, and the speakers' contextual identity, but downstream prose should label it an ironic lexical resonance rather than a semantic gloss of ard.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The jinn speakers place themselves in the earth and deny flight, inviting a test of whether their defining hiddenness offers an exception.

activation_trace.role: The jinn-afflicted ma'rud image creates a peripheral lexical bridge between earth and ahl al-ard.
Disappearing into earth supplies hiddenness as a proposed escape tactic.
Covering and concealment supply the characteristic advantage that is tested and denied.
The hidden jinn identify the speakers as beings for whom concealment might seem especially available.

changed_reading.before: Jinn acknowledge the same physical inability as any fugitive.
changed_reading.after: Even beings characterized by hiddenness cannot turn occult concealment or earth-association into an exception to divine reach.

strongest_changes: The tested and guarded sky recasts the focus conviction as an inference from failed boundary reconnaissance.
Failed social refuge in 72:6 and the messenger's mirrored no-refuge declaration in 72:22 turn a jinn confession into a creaturely invariant.
Divergent paths, helpers, and numbers expand flight from individual locomotion to routes, factions, and coalition power.
Front-rear surveillance and exhaustive encompassing/accounting give physical inescapability an informational mechanism.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated incapacity verb, split between earth and flight, behaved as a compact mechanism hub. Context did not merely repeat divine power; it supplied failed refuge, tested barriers, routed withdrawal, shared creaturely limits, and total surveillance as distinct reasons the paired denials hold.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact force of zann remains live between settled sign-based knowledge and a conclusion still marked by prior epistemic instability.
The sky guards directly regulate listening, so extending them to a fully closed flight topology is an inference rather than an explicit packet arrow.
The causal movement from recognized inescapability to belief in 72:13 may be sequence rather than psychological causation.
The subterranean, rearward-gap, and hidden-jinn readings are contained lexical resonances, not replacement translations.
